title: visual dubbing: a full film in 10 days | sync. labs blog
summary: A 2-hour-45-minute feature. Roughly 800 shots. See how sync. brought Don’t Trouble the Trouble from Telugu into Malayalam with visual dubbing in 10 days.
body_markdown:
*Don’t Trouble the Trouble*[arrived in cinemas on October 2, 2026](https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/telugu/fahadh-faasil-dont-trouble-the-trouble-early-review-mahesh-babu-deeply-moving-10901194/lite/) , in Telugu, Tamil and Malayalam. In the final run-up to release, sync. completed a 10-day full-feature visual dubbing sprint for the Malayalam version, adapting the original Telugu performances to the production’s localized dialogue.


## From the producers behind Baahubali


[Arka Media Works](https://www.arkamediaworks.com/about-us) was founded in 2001 by Shobu Yarlagadda and Prasad Devineni. Its films include *Baahubali: The Beginning* and *Baahubali 2: The Conclusion* ; the first earned India’s[National Film Award for Best Feature Film](https://www.arkamediaworks.com/film/baahubali-the-beginning) .


For *Don’t Trouble the Trouble* , the two producers joined S. S. Karthikeya of Showing Business. The film is presented by S. S. Rajamouli, director of *Baahubali* and[RRR](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/5-reasons-you-must-watch-rrr-the-indian-blockbuster-of-the-year) , whose “Naatu Naatu” won the[2023 Oscar for Best Original Song](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FYt_srWx_V8) .


Directed by Shashank Yeleti, the fantasy drama stars Fahadh Faasil as a magician and Ssara Palekar as a young girl with supernatural powers. Its mix of character performances, action and visual effects made the Malayalam adaptation a substantial test of visual dubbing on finished cinematic footage.
